title: Sport Mode Use and Switching
summary: Feedback about Sport Mode centers on enjoyment of the driving feel for some owners, while other comments focus on having to use Sport Mode to bypass auto stop behavior and many fragments are only inquiries or factual mentions.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the more engaging driving feel in Sport Mode or appreciate strong power delivery without needing to select it every time.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain that disabling auto stop requires putting the vehicle into Sport Mode, which owners find inconvenient or annoying.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly ask about Sport Mode operation, defaults, sounds, break-in guidance, or state that it can disable another function without expressing clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
This topic includes both enjoyment of Sport Mode and procedural questions or workaround mentions, which reduces thematic coherence.
The examples are stratified samples and do not represent overall prevalence beyond the supplied counts.
